comment: Known-vulnerable and known-clean triples, checked against live databases. NOTE: 'vulnerable' entries are stable over time (a published CVE never un-publishes), but a 'clean' entry decays the moment the world finds a CVE — brew:wget@1.25.0 was listed clean on 2026-04-22 and by 2026-08-17 carried CVE-2026-58469..58472 ('GNU Wget through 1.25.0'). Clean cases must therefore assert VERSION FILTERING against an unreleased version rather than the current state of a real release.

vulnerable.reason: CVE-2018-18074 — exposes Authorization header on redirect

CVE-2026-58469/58470/58471/58472 — 'GNU Wget through 1.25.0'. Listed as CLEAN until 2026-08-17; the CPE-first rework surfaced these, the old keyword+resultsPerPage=10 path never fetched them because wget's ten oldest CVEs filled the page.

clean.reason: Unreleased version, above every published wget CVE range — asserts the version filter EXCLUDES out-of-range CVEs. Cannot decay: a future CVE cannot bound a version that does not exist yet.
